audience: agencies and service firms that deliver client orders and helpdesk tickets in Wayfront

useCases.title: Find orders that wait on a client
useCases.text: List the orders, newest first, and filter them by client. Read one order with its deliverables and their latest review decision.

useCases.title: Read a client's tickets and messages
useCases.text: List the tickets, optionally by ticket number. Read all messages of one ticket, from staff and from the client.

useCases.title: Check unpaid invoices and subscriptions
useCases.text: List the invoices of one client and read each invoice with its items and payment state. List the recurring subscriptions too.

useCases.title: Post a staff-only note on an order
useCases.text: Post a message on an order and mark it staff only, so the client does not see it. Confirm the text first.

useCases.title: Add and complete checklist tasks
useCases.text: List the checklist of an order, add a task, and mark a task complete or open again.
